title: This is the most insane creative platform I’ve ever used #shorts
description:
This is the most insane creative platform I’ve ever used.

If you make any type of video content, this is gonna completely change your entire workflow.

What you’re looking at is the latest version of Luma Agents.

These are specially designed creative agents that help make creative work way easier.

To make this video with me and the dog, all we had to do is drop in a single picture of me, one reference photo, and then describe the story we had in our head.

And it built out the entire visual storyboard automatically.

Now just like with all great storytelling, as our creative vision evolved, we just described our new ideas in words, and the creative agents updated, iterated, and built new scenes for us.

You can see how the lighting and visual style progressed overtime as we kept going.

Now these aren’t typical storyboarded sketches.

These are super high quality reference photos, with me in them, that actually make sense based on our creative direction.

From here, we just picked the scene frames we liked and used the latest video models to turn them into clips that we could stitch together.

You can even draw on top of any scene image with their new annotation feature and it will dynamically adjust the scene for you.

Now the reason why this platform is so compelling for creative work is because we didn’t have to figure out how to write our own prompts.

To use it, all you have to do is chat normally in plain English.

And because Luma is powered by these special creative agents, it does kind of feel like you have your own AI Creative Director at all times.

This is one of the only creative platforms that can execute on whatever you need, with taste.

Now to me, this workflow changes everything about the AI creative process.

Because if you’re using this, the storytelling game is now all about brainstorming and ideation, you don’t have to fumble around with complex prompts, workflows, or automations.

It just handles all the complexity for you automatically.

If you want to learn how to use these Luma creative agents, I put together a full PDF breaking down exactly how we made this video with me and the dog.

The models we used, our specs, the step-by-step, everything.

Comment “Luma” and I’ll send it through.
